About Us

The commercial bridge between Ethiopia and China

ETHIO-BRIDGE is built for the businesses doing real trade between two of the world's most dynamic markets — helping them find each other, trust each other, and close deals in their own languages.

Our mission

Remove every barrier between supplier and buyer

Ethiopian buyers import machinery, solar equipment, electronics and consumer goods from China; Ethiopian exporters sell coffee, textiles and agricultural products outward. Historically the journey is blocked by three walls — language, logistics cost visibility, and trust.

ETHIO-BRIDGE tackles all three: live translation across four languages, a tariff and landed-cost calculator built on Ethiopian NBR schedules, and a permissioned, fully audited platform where every action is recorded.

What we stand for

Our values

The principles behind every screen we ship.

🎯

Functional by default

Every feature you see is working — products, RFQs, chat, translation, logistics, wallet. No demo screens.

🛡️

Compliance first

Role-based permissions, immutable audit logs and a transparent 2% commission model regulated by the platform ledger.

🌍

Ethiopian & Chinese at heart

We bridge Addis Ababa and Guangzhou so SMEs on both sides can trade without middlemen or language walls.

🗣️

Language-inclusive

English, Chinese (Simplified), Amharic and Afaan Oromo — with real translation, generated by the platform engine.

Our journey

Built step by step, always real

We ship working functionality and extend it — never mocked screens, never fake quotas. Here is how the platform has come together.

Platform foundation

Core tenant model, security, finance, CRM and product services designed around Ethiopian & Chinese trade scenarios.

Marketplace & negotiation

Multi-language product listings, RFQ hub, and the global negotiation room with auto-translation go live.

Logistics & pricing

Route estimation and Ethiopian customs/VAT landed-cost calculators give buyers total clarity before ordering.

Payments & trust

Wallet, subscriptions and audited platform fees complete the loop — every transaction traceable end-to-end.
